title: Add private beta release preflight check
summary: Add a repeatable release preflight for the signed NSIS private-beta lane so missing updater/signing inputs are caught before running the CI publish workflow.
reason: The next productization step is producing a signed beta artifact, and that should fail early when required secrets, updater keys, workflow inputs, or generated Tauri updater configuration are missing or malformed.
behavior_before: Operators had CI and updater scripts, but no single preflight command to validate the required release secrets, workflow dispatch values, and generated updater-enabled Tauri configuration before attempting a private beta release.
behavior_after: Operators have a release preflight script and tests that validate beta/stable inputs, required secret presence, productization config generation, updater endpoint/channel shape, and signing metadata readiness without exposing secret values.
manual_validation: git diff --check targeted private beta preflight files - passed
refresh_summaries targeted private beta preflight paths - passed
rollback_plan: Remove the preflight script, tests, docs references, generated summaries, and this change packet.
notes: This is release tooling only. It must not change media policy, source/scratch/output movement, pending-publish drain, rename apply, or WebView mutation authority.
